title: A Orbit for the Terminal
author: Casper Crane
blurb: Coral Okonkwo, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
